recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓切片中有多個由類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）緊密聚集而成的肉芽腫，其中含多核巨細胞，未見中央乾酪樣壞死；B、C 特殊染色顯示肉芽腫周圍網狀纖維與膠原纖維增加，符合類肉瘤病（sarcoidosis）的非乾酪性肉芽腫。
features: A: well-formed, confluent granulomas of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated nuclei
A: multinucleated giant cell within a granuloma; no central caseous necrosis
A: rim of lymphocytes and adjacent residual marrow with fat
B: silver-type stain outlining granulomas with a dense surrounding fibrillary network
C: trichrome stain showing blue collagen fibrosis around granulomas next to a bony trabecula
No organisms or atypical lymphoid cells evident at this resolution
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows multiple well-formed, partly confluent granulomas composed of epithelioid histiocytes with a multinucleated giant cell and a peripheral lymphocytic rim, without caseous necrosis. A reticulin-type silver stain outlines the granulomas with increased surrounding fibers, and a trichrome stain shows associated collagen fibrosis adjacent to bony trabeculae. Findings are consistent with noncaseating granulomatous inflammation of the marrow; sarcoidosis is a diagnosis of exclusion, so special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi, cultures, and evaluation for lymphoma and drug exposure should be completed.

ddx.vs: TB granulomas often show caseous necrosis and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain or positive cultures.
Fungal granulomas contain yeasts demonstrable with GMS or PAS stains, often in immunocompromised hosts.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or T-cell lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Lymphoma-associated granulomas harbor CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin cells or atypical lymphoid infiltrates on IHC.
Lipogranulomas are small, incidental collections of histiocytes around fat vacuoles without confluent epithelioid granulomas or fibrosis.
